title: orobanche alba var. raddeana
intro: Orobanche alba var. raddeana, commonly known as  a type of parasitic flowering plant, specifically a holoparasite that obtains its nutrients by connecting to the roots of its host plant. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Orobanche alba var. raddeana include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
